verdicts.reason: A keeps a clean left-aligned column with a strong headline, a single chip row and a clear CTA. However, the SOLSTICE wordmark has dropped below the headline and is oversized, so it competes with the headline. The chip order is reversed and the bottom gap is tight. B mixes a left-aligned text block with centred stacked chips. Its chips have inconsistent widths (HONEY ROSEMARY is much wider than the others) and are out of order. The headline, wordmark and subcopy are squeezed against the left edge with no breathing room, so the layout looks disjointed and unplanned.
